domains.name: Commerce
domains.description: Commerce analytics domain for the Shopify-centered modern data platform. It is the parent governance domain; consumer-facing datasets are assigned to one leaf domain when a more specific business process exists.

domains.name: Order & Sales
domains.description: Orders, order items, sales amounts, discounts, and order-cohort analysis.

domains.name: Payments
domains.description: Payment authorization, collection, refund transactions, and payment status analysis.

domains.name: Refunds
domains.description: Refund events, refunded items, sales reversals, and refund analysis.

domains.name: Fulfillment
domains.description: Fulfillment, shipment, delivery, and fulfillment-event analysis.

domains.name: Commerce Reference
domains.description: Shared reference entities such as Stores and Items used across commerce processes.

groups.description: Business ownership for commerce concepts, metrics, and consumer-facing analytical assets.
Technical ownership and stewardship for ingestion, lakehouse, dbt, orchestration, metadata, and governed agent infrastructure.

tags.description: Technical discovery label for metadata originating from Shopify.
Asset participates in the dbt / MetricFlow semantic graph.
Asset follows the business-key plus record-hash versioning contract.
Asset participates in the daily execution responsibility model.

structured_properties.description: Governed handling classification for commerce datasets.

allowed_values.description: Internal business data with standard access controls.
Sensitive business data requiring tighter access controls.
Highly restricted data requiring explicit authorization.

structured_properties.description: Business impact tier used for governance, incident prioritization, and discovery.

allowed_values.description: Low business impact if stale or unavailable.
Useful analytical asset with moderate business impact.
Important consumer-facing asset supporting core commerce analysis.

structured_properties.description: Governance state controlling how strongly an AI/Data Agent may rely on this dataset. Runtime verification is intentionally stronger than semantic readiness.

allowed_values.description: Discoverable context; not approved as a primary analytical answer source.
Modeled and semantically governed, but real Runtime evidence may still be deferred.
